items.title: Axon Sinks 17% on Revenue Miss, Guidance Cut and $1.2 Billion Skydio Bet on “Millions of Drones”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAxon shares fell 17% after third-quarter revenue of $909 million missed estimates and the company cut its 2026 growth outlook to about 30%. About $130 million of delayed federal Dedrone deployments drove the cut, while software and services revenue grew 43%, so this looks like timing.

items.title: Why Is Motorola Solutions (MSI) Bringing More AI Features To Its Devices?
items.summary: Motorola Solutions (NYSE:MSI) is partnering with Taboola to bring the DeeperDive AI answer engine to select moto g lockscreens. A separate collaboration with Glance InMobi and Lenovo Qira introduces AI-led shopping and personalized recommendations across Motorola phones and Lenovo PCs. items.title: Why Everyone Is Watching Motorola Solutions (MSI) Today
items.summary: Motorola Solutions (MSI) just delivered third quarter 2026 results that topped Wall Street forecasts on both revenue and earnings, then followed up by lifting full year guidance and outlining stronger expectations for the coming quarter. Motorola Solutions has ridden this earnings beat into a strong run, with a 1-month share price return of 9.14% and a year-to-date share price gain of 30.44%.
